l2_pair_order_min.quantity: minimum post-asymptotic L2 pair order over structured ladders (worst: distorted/exp_trig_harmonic)

l2_finest_order_window.quantity: smallest finest-pair L2 order over every ladder (worst: distorted/quadratic_harmonic)

power_law_residual.reference: error sequence follows the theoretical power law (GATE_POWER_LAW)

control_exact.quantity: worst absolute error of the P1-representable linear control (all meshes)

flux_balance.quantity: max |Dirichlet reaction + imposed Neumann flux| and max free-dof residual (cosh_cos_neumann)

quadrature_independence.quantity: relative change of the L2 norm when the 7-point rule is refined by 4-way subdivision (sine_generation, level 32)
quadrature_independence.reference: measured order is a property of the discretisation, not of the rule

skfem_matrix_xval.quantity: relative difference of the assembled conductivity matrices

diagonal_symmetry.quantity: largest relative L2 difference between the two diagonal splits at the finest mesh
diagonal_symmetry.reference: the rate must not depend on the split direction (GATE_DIAGONAL)
